audio_prompts.purpose: Listening model for short Week 3 garment descriptions with category and feature language.
audio_prompts.script: Look at the garment cards. Number one: This is a black jacket. It is outerwear. It has a zipper and pockets. Number two: These are blue jeans. They are casual. They have pockets. Number three: This is a white blouse. It is a top. It has buttons and long sleeves. Number four: This is a red dress. It is a one-piece garment. It is for a party. Number five: These are shorts. They are casual and they are for hot weather.
audio_prompts.speaker_profile: One adult teacher or Fashion Design classroom instructor speaking clearly to beginner learners.
audio_prompts.accent_or_variety: Clear international English suitable for Brazilian A2 learners.
audio_prompts.voice_direction: Warm, clear, and teacher-like, with short pauses after each numbered garment description.
audio_prompts.suggested_openai_voice_role: Choose an available OpenAI or ChatGPT voice at generation time that sounds like a supportive classroom teacher.
